title: Restored Hearts Retreat
description: A weekend retreat for Christian singles to reconnect with God and find authentic community in the mountains. Includes worship sessions, small group discussions, hiking, and evening bonfires.

title: Kingdom Singles Conference
description: A two-day conference bringing together Christian singles from across the Southeast for powerful worship, inspiring speakers, and intentional networking. Topics include faith, purpose, and relationships.

title: Friday Night Worship & Fellowship
description: An intimate worship night open to all Christian singles in the Dallas area. Expect Spirit-led praise, a short devotional, and time to connect over coffee afterward.

title: Faith & Friendship Social Mixer
description: A fun, relaxed social event for Christian singles in Chicago. Activities include icebreaker games, group discussions, and a casual dinner — a great way to meet other believers in the city.

title: Heal & Thrive Singles Weekend
description: A healing retreat for singles walking through life transitions — divorce recovery, grief, or simply seeking renewed purpose. Led by licensed Christian counselors and pastors.

title: Rooted: Young Adults Conference
description: A high-energy conference for Christian singles aged 22–38. Three days of worship, breakout sessions, and evening socials. Speakers include nationally recognized pastors and authors.

title: Serve Together: Community Day
description: Spend a Saturday serving the Houston community alongside other Christian singles. Projects include food pantry volunteering, neighborhood cleanup, and mentorship activities.

title: Alive in Christ Worship Night
description: A powerful evening of contemporary worship led by local Christian musicians. Designed for singles who want to encounter God and leave refreshed and encouraged.

title: Single & Purposeful Brunch
description: A monthly brunch gathering for Christian singles in Seattle. Enjoy good food, meaningful conversation, and a short devotional to start your Saturday with intention.

title: Living Faith Couples & Singles Gala
description: An elegant annual gala for Christian singles and couples in NYC. Enjoy live music, dinner, dancing, and testimonies of lives changed by faith and community.

title: Faith Walk: Coastal Prayer Hike
description: A guided 5-mile coastal hike with prayer stations along the trail. Open to singles of all fitness levels. Ends with a beach bonfire, worship, and group prayer.

title: Anchored Singles Conference
description: Three days of teaching, worship, and connection focused on helping singles discover their God-given identity and purpose. Nationally renowned speakers and breakout sessions.

title: Illuminate: Creative Arts Worship
description: A unique worship night blending music, spoken word, visual art, and dance — all in celebration of God's creativity. Open to all singles who love to express faith through art.

title: Deep Roots Men's Retreat
description: A weekend retreat exclusively for single Christian men. Topics include identity, integrity, and purpose. Includes group Bible study, hiking, and open campfire discussions.

title: She Is Whole: Women's Worship Day
description: A full-day event for single Christian women including worship, prayer, panel discussions, and a workshop on faith and emotional health. Brunch and lunch provided.

title: Lighthouse Singles Mixer
description: A casual evening mixer for Christian singles in Boston. Held at a local community center with games, coffee, and guided conversation starters rooted in faith values.

title: Overflow: Sunday Evening Praise
description: A bilingual (English/Spanish) Sunday praise night for Christian singles in Miami. Featuring live worship, testimonies, and a short message followed by fellowship.
